termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: Welcome to BrightSmile Dental Clinic. By accessing our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully before using our services.
termsOfService.s1Body: BrightSmile Dental Clinic provides professional dental care services including general dentistry, cosmetic procedures, orthodontics, and emergency dental care. All services are performed by licensed dental professionals in compliance with applicable health regulations.
termsOfService.s2Body: Appointments must be scheduled in advance. We kindly request at least 24 hours notice for cancellations. Repeated missed appointments without notice may result in restrictions on future bookings. Emergency appointments are available and subject to availability.
termsOfService.s3Body: Payment is due at the time of service unless prior arrangements have been made. We accept most major insurance plans. Patients are responsible for verifying their own insurance coverage. Any balance not covered by insurance is the patient's responsibility.
termsOfService.s4Body: Patients are responsible for providing accurate and complete medical history, including current medications and allergies. Providing false information may compromise your safety and the quality of care you receive. Patients must follow post-treatment instructions provided by our dental professionals.
termsOfService.s5Body: Your personal and medical information is collected and used solely for providing dental care and related administrative purposes. We are committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with applicable laws. Please refer to our Privacy Policy for full details.
termsOfService.s6Body: BrightSmile Dental Clinic is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services beyond the limits permitted by law. Our liability is limited to the direct cost of the specific dental service in question.
termsOfService.s7Body: These terms are governed by the laws of Lebanon. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Beirut, Lebanon. If any provision of these Terms is found to be unenforceable, the remaining provisions will continue in full force and effect.
termsOfService.contactBody: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at contact@brightsmile.com or call +961 1 234 567.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At BrightSmile Dental Clinic, we are committed to protecting your privacy and the confidentiality of your personal and medical information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data.
privacyPolicy.s1Body: We collect personal information you provide when registering or using our services, including your name, contact details, date of birth, and insurance information. We also collect medical history, dental records, and treatment details necessary for providing dental care.
privacyPolicy.s2Body: Your information is used to provide and improve dental care services, schedule and manage appointments, process insurance claims and payments, send appointment reminders and health communications, and comply with legal and regulatory requirements.
privacyPolicy.s3Body: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with treating dental professionals within our clinic, insurance providers for claims processing, and regulatory authorities when required by law. All third parties are bound by strict confidentiality obligations.
privacyPolicy.s4Body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Our systems use encryption for data in transit and at rest. Access to patient records is strictly controlled and limited to authorized personnel.
privacyPolicy.s5Body: You have the right to access your personal and medical records, request corrections to inaccurate information, request deletion of your data where legally permissible, and opt out of non-essential communications. To exercise these rights, please contact our clinic directly.
privacyPolicy.s6Body: BrightSmile Dental Clinic is committed to complying with applicable healthcare privacy laws, including HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) standards where applicable. We maintain a Notice of Privacy Practices available upon request.
privacyPolicy.s7Body: Our online patient portal uses essential cookies to maintain your session and provide core functionality. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies. By using our online services, you consent to our use of necessary cookies.
privacyPolicy.contactBody: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at contact@brightsmile.com or call +961 1 234 567.
